note: Locked synthetic persona-language case per exposed operation, one per story turn. Prompts avoid operation names and preserve the sales-lead approval boundary.

cases.onepager_bullet: Assesses campaign risk against plan each week to spot under-delivery before the advertiser does
cases.prompt: Is the Harborlight Streaming campaign falling behind this week, and by how much?

cases.onepager_bullet: Finds available reach across placements, such as a home-screen takeover, to close the gap
cases.prompt: Where can we find extra reach this week to close the Harborlight gap?

cases.onepager_bullet: Drafts the recommendation for approval so the sales lead can review it and share it with the advertiser
cases.prompt: Draft the make-good for Harborlight so Maya can review it. Don't send anything to the advertiser yet.
